title: Adaptive pinflow + telemetry for embedding & reranker onboarding
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Problem: Current onboarding flow always either pins immediately or uses a static staged rollout. For embedding + reranker pairs this leads to suboptimal trade-offs: some candidates need immediate pin for stable latency, others benefit from staged rollouts to capture dataset-specific quality regressions. We need an adaptive pinflow that chooses pin strategy based on early-run signal, plus richer telemetry surfaced in profile publishes so PMs and SREs can reason about rollouts and unit economics.

Goal: Build an adaptive pinning orchestration and extend the profile publishing pipeline to include per-variant telemetry (latency percentiles, token-level cost, recall/ndcg slices, cache hit rates, failure modes). Provide automated gates (quality + perf) that determine whether to complete a pin, revert, or continue staged canary. Integrate with Console rollouts UI and add a lightweight audit trail to profile artifacts.

Out of scope: full retraining or model quality fixes; deep integration with on-prem rollout automation (follow-up ticket).
acceptance_criteria: Adaptive Orchestrator: onboarding service can run a candidate through a short live validation cohort and choose one of: immediate pin, staged canary (X% traffic), or reject based on gates
Telemetry in profile: published profile JSON includes p50/p95 latency, per-token cost estimate, recall@1/5, ndcg@10, cache-hit ratio, and sample error traces
Automated Gates: quality gate (delta vs baseline on recall/ndcg) and perf gate (p95 latency within SLO) evaluate and produce pass/warn/fail
Canary rollout automation: when staged canary is chosen, the system configures rollout rules and emits rollback hooks to Console
Dashboards: new Console dashboards show per-variant telemetry for recent onboarded pairs and historical trend lines
End-to-end test: CI job simulates onboarding a toy embed+rera dataset and asserts final published profile contains telemetry and a pin decision field
Documentation: PRD + runbook links included in ticket; onboarding API docs updated
notes: Decision: start with short live validation cohort (1k requests distributed across user slices) rather than synthetic-only tests to surface production distribution differences
Trade-off: live cohorts increase cost and slight risk to users; we mitigate by routing to internal test-users and <1% traffic for initial evaluation
Fallback behavior: if telemetry reporting fails mid-flight, orchestrator should abort and leave candidate unpinned
Rollout percent plan: default staged canary steps are 1% -> 5% -> 20% -> 100% with manual gating at 5% and 20%
Telemetry retention: profile publishes include 7-day aggregated metrics; long-term retention handled by Console observability add-on (separate billing)
tasks: Design adaptive pinflow state machine and APIs
Extend profile-publish schema to accept telemetry fields and sample traces
Implement live validation harness to drive short cohorts against a golden baseline
Add gate evaluation library (quality + perf thresholds + configurable tolerance)
Integrate with Console rollout service: submit staged rules and rollback hooks
Add CI integration test and e2e harness for small dataset
Author runbook for operators and update onboarding docs
